notes: §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR5: 'If specified, data-name-1 may be referenced only by a GENERATE statement, the UPON phrase of a SUM clause, a USE BEFORE REPORTING sentence, or as a sum counter qualifier.' The admitted shapes resolve through ReportGroupResolution (GENERATE, UPON, USE BEFORE REPORTING) and sum-counter qualification; any other reference that names a report entry reaches NameResolution#ReportUnidentified -> ReportSectionBinder#ReportEntryReferenceRefused (COBOL5092) at every edition, and the 2023-only SUM-operand reference is refused by ScreenRolledAddend (a group carries no value, COBOL2730). Probes at --std 85 (class b refusal half; class d group vs elementary): DISPLAY/MOVE SPACES TO/IF ... = SPACES/ADD 1 TO/INITIALIZE of a format 1 name each refused COBOL5092; SOURCE DET in another group refused COBOL2144; SUM DET (the 2023 SUM-operand arm, class c) refused COBOL2730; the legal program with GENERATE DET, SUM WS-N UPON DET, USE BEFORE REPORTING CFG and MOVE TOT OF CFG ran and printed T=00014 / BEFORE CF / DONE. The witness (DISPLAY DETAIL-LINE) is refused COBOL5092. The message cites §2023:13.15.3 SR7 including its 2023 SUM-operand permission at --std 85, the edition-citation class owned by PB4950; the refusal itself is the 1985 rule. Classes a, e, f do not apply to a name-reference rule.

next.reason: 1985: "may be referenced only by a GENERATE statement, the UPON phrase of a SUM clause, a USE BEFORE REPORTING sentence, or as a sum counter qualifier"; 2023: "in the UPON phrase of the SUM clause, or as an operand in a SUM clause. The data-name shall not be referenced in any other way.". Same rule on when the group data-name is required and how it may be referenced, but 2023 adds a permitted reference as an operand in a SUM clause, which 1985 forbids.
